name: Hold a bent shape with 50 g hung on the tip
metric: tip sag under the load, sleeve jammed and cables slack
note: cables holding the load: 10.2 mm sag; jamming with cables slack first lets the backbone relax the tip +8.0 mm, then the load sags it 2.5 mm; unjammed and slack it drops 68 mm

name: Place the tip on a point in space
note: target [139, 69, 79] mm, commanded bend 142 deg to reach a 120 deg arc, cable stretch corrected in the loop

name: Pinch a 20 mm cube and hold it when its support is removed
metric: cube height kept after the pedestal drops
note: 2 tendril contacts, 0.66 N normal force at the pinch, cube started at 145 mm

name: Wrap a 60 mm bar and resist a 2 N pull on the tip
note: 7 of 14 vertebrae in contact after the wrap, 24.9 N total normal force; 6 still in contact under the pull; cables locked, sleeve jammed

name: Cage a ball and hold it against a 1 N push
note: the same push on the ball alone rolls it off the base

name: Hover eight tips over eight floor pads at once
metric: worst tip error of the eight
note: errors 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4 mm; tips held 12 mm above pads 24 mm wide at 152 mm from the centre, on the reachable surface of a 170 deg arc, all eight tendrils controlled in the same loop

name: Thread the tip through a 22 mm ring
metric: tip miss from the ring centre
note: the ring sits on the reachable arc of tendril 0, tilted to the arc tangent; drawn as a target with no contact
